## Generated Files — Regenerate, Don't Edit

**Impact: HIGH**

Hand-editing these files will be overwritten on the next regen and will diverge from the schema/source they're derived from.

| Path                              | Generated by                              | Regenerate with                        |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `packages/db/src/migrations/`     | `drizzle-kit generate` from schema        | `bun db:generate` (then user applies); SQL body replaced by hand only as below |
| `.next/`                          | `next build` / `next dev`                 | rebuild                                |
| `dist/`                           | `tsdown` / package builds                 | rebuild                                |
| `*.tsbuildinfo`                   | `tsc` incremental                         | rebuild                                |
| `node_modules/`                   | `bun install`                             | reinstall                              |
| tRPC `AppRouter` (inferred type)  | inferred from `routers/index.ts`          | edit procedures, type follows          |

### Hand-written migration SQL

`drizzle-kit generate` writes the SQL it can infer from the schema diff. When that SQL would be wrong for the data — a type change it can only express as `ALTER COLUMN … SET DATA TYPE` over values that do not cast — still run `bun db:generate` first: only it writes the snapshot under `meta/` and the journal entry that the next diff builds on. Then replace the SQL body of the file it created, and open the file with a comment saying what drizzle-kit generated and why it was replaced. Keep `--> statement-breakpoint` between statements; the migrator splits on it. Never edit `meta/`.

`drizzle-kit generate --custom` is not the tool for this: it writes an empty migration and copies the *previous* snapshot, so a schema change written into it is generated again by the next `db:generate`. Use it only for data-only migrations.

### Database commands

**Never** run `drizzle-kit push` or `drizzle-kit migrate` without explicit user approval. Generate the migration, show it to the user, let the user apply.

(See `knowledge-base.md` and memory: `feedback_no_db_commands`.)
